contract.tlp_prefix_wire_bytes: 0000+seq[11:8], seq[7:0]; physical STP framing bits excluded
contract.tlp_coverage: Both sequence bytes and all TLP bytes including optional ECRC; received LCRC validated separately; ECRC semantics remain separate
contract.crc32: Normal04C11DB7/reflectedEDB88320; seedFFFFFFFF; complement; each input byte LSBfirst; reflected complemented remainder lowbytefirst on wire
contract.crc16: Normal100B/reflectedD008; seedFFFF; all four DLLP body bytes LSBfirst; complement and reverse normal remainder to lowbytefirst reflected wire value
contract.nullification: EDB plus valid inverted ordinary LCRC => nullified; EDB plus incorrect inverse => CRC error; all drop without retirement
contract.ordinary_crc_failure: Drop whole packet and report per-slot CRC error; preserve successor and epoch when framing is legal
